verdict.rationale: Muse documents a Forget skill that erases information about specific topics or people, and says users can inspect, edit and download VM files, including Muse's memory about them. A training opt-out switch also gives some control over how data is used. Evidence covers selective forgetting and file-level control, but nothing on retention periods, and continuous VM backups make it unclear whether deleted data actually expires. Missing for 10: configurable retention windows, full account/data deletion, deletion handling for backups and training data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
